source.notes: Coordinates: see coord_source / coord_source_url of each site (NASA NSSDCA tables, LROC, USGS planetary nomenclature). elevation_m / slope_deg: LOLA maps at the point. Catalogue and exclusions: data/SITES.md.

sites.name: Chang'e 5
sites.coord_source: LROC (Arizona State University) image 1172: 43.0576 N, 308.0839 E, -2570 m; same position in the NSSDCA landing sites table
sites.description: Sample return, Oceanus Procellarum.

sites.name: Chang'e 6
sites.coord_source: LROC (Arizona State University) image 1374: 41.6385 S, 206.0148 E, -5256 m; same position in the NSSDCA landing sites table
sites.description: First far-side sample return, Apollo basin.

sites.name: Chandrayaan-3 (Vikram)
sites.coord_source: LROC (Arizona State University) image 1314: 69.3741 S, 32.32 E, 532 m; same position in the NSSDCA landing sites table
sites.description: Southernmost landing before 2024; about 600 km from the south pole.

sites.name: SLIM
sites.coord_source: LROC (Arizona State University) image 1358: 13.3160 S, 25.2510 E, -912 m; same position in the NSSDCA landing sites table
sites.description: Precision landing near Shioli crater; came to rest upside down.

sites.name: IM-1 Odysseus (Intuitive Machines)
sites.coord_source: LROC (Arizona State University) image 1360: 80.13 S, 1.44 E, 2579 m; same position in the NSSDCA landing sites table
sites.description: First commercial landing, near Malapert A; tipped over on touchdown.

sites.name: IM-2 Athena (Intuitive Machines)
sites.coord_source: LROC (Arizona State University) image 1408: 84.7906 S, 29.1957 E; intended site 84.78 S, 29.13 E (image 1401); same position in the NSSDCA landing sites table
sites.description: Mons Mouton; came to rest on its side in a small crater.

sites.name: Blue Ghost Mission 1 (Firefly)
sites.coord_source: LROC (Arizona State University) image 1407: 18.5623 N, 61.8103 E, -3650 m; same position in the NSSDCA landing sites table
sites.description: Mons Latreille, Mare Crisium; first fully successful commercial landing.

sites.name: IM-3 target: Reiner Gamma (Intuitive Machines)
sites.coord_source: Target named in the NASA CLPS AGU 2025 poster (Haviland et al., NTRS 20250011367); coordinates = IAU centre of the Reiner Gamma swirl (USGS Gazetteer of Planetary Nomenclature, feature 4987, LOLA 2011 control net)
sites.description: Planned landing at the Reiner Gamma swirl (73 km). The exact site is not published: marker = centre of the swirl.

sites.name: HAKUTO-R Mission 1 (ispace)
sites.coord_source: LROC (Arizona State University) image 1302: debris at 47.581 N, 44.094 E, near the nominal landing site; same position in the NSSDCA landing sites table
sites.description: Landing attempt near Atlas crater ended in a crash.

sites.name: HAKUTO-R Mission 2 Resilience (ispace)
sites.coord_source: LROC (Arizona State University) image 1456: impact at 60.4445 N, 355.4120 E; planned landing area 60.5 N, 355.4 E (image 1412); same position in the NSSDCA landing sites table
sites.description: Landing attempt in Mare Frigoris ended in a hard landing.
